intent: Cluster test for the SetPriority control command: validates its input checking, then exercises priority-driven leadership changes, quorum protection, and priority-conflict rejection across a 6-node cluster.

objects.name: findPeer
objects.role: polls a node's Status peerList for a named peer's parsed STable, retrying until found or timeout

objects.name: waitForPeerField
objects.role: polls until a named peer's given field equals an expected value

objects.name: setPriority
objects.role: sends SetPriority with the given value and asserts a 200

objects.name: SetPriorityTest::testValidation
objects.role: missing/reserved/negative priority values are rejected with 400s

objects.name: SetPriorityTest::testPriorityScenarios
objects.role: all six-node priority scenarios (repriority, forced stand-down both directions, permafollower promotion/demotion, conflict rejection, quorum-breaking rejection) in one method to reuse one cluster

naming_quality.note: consistent camelCase helpers/methods; setPriority (helper) vs SetPriority (command) reads clearly from context
